pages.title: 黑暗祭坛（The Dark Shrine）
pages.text: 维度 64，又被称为腐肉-485，其中有一座能够引导极大量黑暗能量的祭坛。$(br2)这个结构由八根围成圆形的石柱与一根中央石柱组成。

pages.title: The Dark Shrine
pages.text: Inside of dimension 64, also known to some as Carrion-485, there exists a shrine that is capable of channelling an insane amount of dark energy. $(br2)This construct consists of 8 pillars standing in a circle around one central pillar.
